title: Clery Officer: Classify Before MSU Alert, Parent Post on Riverside

fields.to: Director of University Communications; Chief of Campus Police
fields.subject: RE: Flash Flood Warning – classification before MSU Alert
fields.body:
Tobias Ng, Chief,

The county WEA just went to every phone on campus. Before our MSU Alert goes out, I need a decision with the Chief and the IC. Is this an emergency notification under 34 CFR 668.46(g), or an informational message? Nobody has been ordered to evacuate yet.

Please don't send anything labelled 'emergency notification' until we've talked. I'll log the decision, the time and the reason, as section 3 of the Notification and Shelter SOP requires. I'm at my desk and on my cell.

Also, this went up in the MSU Parents & Families Facebook group a few minutes ago and is moving fast. Screenshot attached:

Proud Marlowe Mom 2029: "My daughter's phone just SCREAMED a flash flood warning at 6:40 and MSU has said NOTHING. I called the parent line, (740-555-0150, and got voicemail. Somebody in the comments says the creek is already in Riverside's basement. Is it?? #MarloweFlood"
58 comments in 5 minutes.

I don't know if the basement claim is true. Someone needs to check before we answer it.
fields.signature:
Hannah Fitch
Clery Compliance Officer
Marlowe State University | 740-555-0121

instructorNote: This is a pressure inject. Under MENSO 3, a life-safety warning about an immediate threat counts as an emergency notification. Watch whether CPD, the Clery Officer and the IC agree on the classification and log it quickly, so the 06:55 MSU Alert doesn't slip. Also watch whether the PIO waits for Facilities to confirm the Riverside basement claim before answering it, and puts a holding message on the voicemail-only parent line.

citations.quote: - **Director of Emergency Management (Renata Voss, 740-555-0102):** serves as Incident Commander (IC) for the first operational period. Activates the Emergency Operations Center (EOC). Authority to or

citations.documentTitle: MSU-EM-SOP-03: Emergency Notification and Shelter Operations
citations.headingPath: MENSO › 3. Which kind of message is it
citations.quote: The Clery Act requires two kinds of campus messages. The Clery Compliance Officer decides with the Chief of Campus Police and the IC; the decision, the time and the reason go in the notification log.

citations.documentTitle: MSU Emergency Operations Plan, Annex F: Flash Flooding
citations.headingPath: MSU Emergency Operations Plan, A… › 6. Notification
citations.quote: Notification follows the Notification and Shelter SOP (course document 4): MSU Alert (text, email, voice, desktop banner and 18 outdoor sirens), the university home page banner, social media, RA phone
